title:
This epic handles search for sensors in the dropdown in 'DiagramParsing.DiagramDetailSensorMatchVerificationGrid'
It listens to two kind of actions:
For 'SENSOR_SEARCH_CHANGED' =>
        the epic updates 'sensorSearchOptions' field in state which is shown in the dropdown.
For 'CLEAR_SENSOR_SEARCH' =>
        the epic performs cleanup resetting 'sensorSearchOptions' field in state to default sensor options.
name: UpdateSensorDropdown
